title: Aphelion Shop Lab production planning checkpoint
content:
Aphelion Shop Lab took a meaningful step from commerce brainstorming into a usable internal production-planning surface. The important choice was restraint: this is not a public storefront, not checkout, and not yet a Shopify or Printful integration. It is the workspace before that, where image groups can become product candidates without committing to a sales system too early.

What changed:

  • Shop groups became editable objects: postcard packs, shirt/series folders, and miscellany now carry editable title, description, product type, status, fulfillment/category, production notes, pricing notes, and sample notes.
  • Curation and shop planning are connected: Shop Lab images can jump back into Curation for identity edits, while image lightboxes show title, description, code/path, set, rarity/status, attributes, and source tags when available.
  • Large sets are easier to work with: group cards stay compact at ten preview images, titles open scrollable full-set panels, and full sets can now be reordered by drag-and-drop with automatic saving.
  • The vocabulary is manageable: product types, statuses, and fulfillment categories can be edited from Options instead of being locked into code.
  • Production handoff is starting: JSON and CSV exports now give the Shop Lab data a path toward Shopify draft planning, Printful/MOO/local-printer notes, or a manual production sheet later.

The trajectory here matters because Aphelion is becoming more than a browsing wall. The work now has a bridge from selection and curation into product thinking: private, reversible, exportable, and still grounded in the actual image folders.
